Syngonium.reason: Orchidaceae cross-contamination from gaspadorius scraper — Syngonium is Araceae, not an orchid. The 'Orchidėja bulbophyllum longiflorum' label belongs to a completely different orchid species.
Syngonium.evidence: https://lt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Singonis (Wikidata Q2448411, confirmed Araceae family). Primary name 'Singonis' is already correct.

Schefflera.reason: iNat reverse-synonym contamination — 'Nėrūnė' is the LT name for an unrelated genus (likely Centaurea or similar), not Schefflera. Schefflera (Araliaceae) has no other established LT name besides 'Šeflera'.
Schefflera.evidence: Pre-db confirms Schefflera → Araliaceae. Primary 'Šeflera' is the established LT form (gaspadorius source). 'Nėrūnė' came from inat reverse-lookup error and does not appear in any LT botanical reference for Schefflera.

Stephanandra.reason: CRITICAL: ltName is set to a completely unrelated species ('Arabidopsis thaliana' — thale cress, Brassicaceae). Stephanandra is a Rosaceae genus and has no established LT common name. Source 'plants' (data/plants.json) appears corrupted at this entry. Plus plantsJsonFamily='Rosaceae' is correct but the name was misassigned.
Stephanandra.evidence: Wikipedia (en) lists no Lithuanian translation for Stephanandra. Latin 'Arabidopsis thaliana' is the model organism mouse-ear cress — entirely different family (Brassicaceae). Pre-db family=ROSACEAE confirms genus is real, just no LT name available.

Reinwardtia.reason: ltName is the species Latin binomial ('Reinwardtia indica'), not a Lithuanian name. Reinwardtia is a monotypic-ish genus (Linaceae) with no established LT common name. Source 'gaspadorius' likely scraped the Latin epithet as label.
Reinwardtia.evidence: Wikipedia (en) lists no Lithuanian translation. Common EN names are 'yellow flax' / 'pyoli'. No LT form found in derlingas, sodospalvos, or wiki LT.

Hoya.reason: Wikipedia disambiguation page suffix '(reikšmės)' leaked into synonyms; ltFamily was set to 'Nuorodiniai straipsniai' (Wikipedia category 'Reference articles'), which is not a taxonomic family. Primary name 'Vaškuolė' is correct.
Hoya.evidence: wikiUrl points to 'Vaškuolė_(reikšmės)' which is a disambiguation page, not a botanical article. Hoya is Apocynaceae (formerly Asclepiadaceae).

Lotus.reason: Same disambiguation leak pattern. 'Lotus (reikšmės)' is the Wikipedia disambiguation page title, not a botanical synonym.
Lotus.evidence: Lotus is a Fabaceae genus. 'Garždenis' is the established LT name.

Vanda.reason: Wikipedia disambiguation suffix '(ežeras)' — refers to a lake in Antarctica, not the orchid genus Vanda. Primary name 'Vandos' is correct.
Vanda.evidence: Wikidata confirms Vanda is an orchid genus (Orchidaceae). 'Vanda (ežeras)' Wikipedia article is about an Antarctic lake.

secondaryFixesFamilyOnly.comment: These entries have ltFamily='Nuorodiniai straipsniai' (Wikipedia disambig category, not a real family). The ltName is correct or acceptable; only ltFamily needs clearing.

Acer.note: ltName='Acer' is suspect (should be 'Klevas' per Wikipedia https://lt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Klevas), but secondary; primary issue is family field.

Darwin.note: ENTIRE entry suspect — 'Darwin' is not a real plant genus (botanical genus is 'Darwinia'). Likely pre-db artifact. manualReviewNeeded.

Mandragora.note: ltName='Mandragora' (=Latin) is acceptable LT loan word.

knownNonPlantEntries.comment: Genera names that have wiki articles about non-plants (people, concepts, lakes). The pre-db.json may list them as plant genera (which could be artifacts of source scraping). Audit decision: do NOT fix here — escalate to pre-db audit task.
